claims: Deep learning is a subset of machine learning.
Deep learning is based on artificial neural networks with multiple layers.
Artificial neural networks with multiple layers are called deep architectures.
Deep learning analyzes complex, unstructured data such as images, sound, text.
Deep learning learns patterns automatically.
Deep learning powers self-driving cars.
Deep learning powers image recognition.
Deep learning powers natural language processing.
Neural networks are layered algorithms inspired by the human brain.
Neural networks process data.
Representation learning is the ability to automatically learn patterns from raw data.
Representation learning does not require manual feature engineering.
Backpropagation is an algorithm for updating neural network parameters (weights) to minimize errors.
Hidden layers are multiple layers between input and output.
Hidden layers enable deep learning of complex representations.
Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) are used for sequential data such as text, speech, or time series.
Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) is a specialized RNN.
LSTM is capable of learning long-term dependencies in sequential data.
Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) consist of two networks competing against each other.
GANs create new, synthetic data instances.
Deep learning systems use hierarchical layers to extract features from data.
Deep learning requires massive amounts of labeled data for training.
Deep learning demands heavy computation power.
Deep learning demands long training times.
Deep learning models are often difficult to understand how they arrived at a specific decision.
